purpose: Map layer for the Superset dashboard: each tender row carries its district polygon.
grain: One row per tender with a district boundary attached.

quirks.text: Has 81 of the 112 tenders in the main file. Missing tenders by DISTRICT_FINALISED: {'NA': 13, 'KAMRUP METRO': 13, 'BARPETA': 4, 'NAGAON': 1}. Why the geotagged ones were dropped is not documented. Never use for totals.
geometry and polygons hold full boundary coordinates (~2 MB file). Do not send them to the LLM; drop them before profiling or narration.
dtname differs from district_finalised on 4 rows (CONFLICT rows and the SIVSAGAR spelling).
